name: campfire orbit
description: Twenty seconds at 60 fps that move the camera round, towards and away from the fire with the view swinging across it, from twenty metres to two (roadmap R112): a turn in place at twelve metres, in to five across the near flame's switch, a turn in place at five, round to the smoke's downwind side, in to two, and a strafe out to twenty. Flown with --world-rate 0 the flame and the smoke stand still, so whatever changes between frames is the camera's; README.md says what each marker shows.

markers.name: turn-12m
markers.note: Twelve metres east, the view turning across the fire: the flame past the near march's switch.

markers.name: in-5m
markers.note: Five metres east after coming in across the switch: the near flame marched per pixel.

markers.name: turn-5m
markers.note: Five metres east, the view turning across the flame and up the smoke.

markers.name: close
markers.note: Two metres from the flame on its north-west side.

markers.name: out-15m
markers.note: Strafing out on the west side, fifteen metres from the fire.
